additions.site_name: Huawei Cloud Horinger Data Center — Yungu West Zone
additions.name: Huawei Cloud Horinger Yungu West Zone Phase 1 — second-batch works (2# data-centre machine-room building and 2# generator platform)

status.summary: On 23 September 2026 the Horinger New Area planning and construction bureau reported that the second-batch construction works of the Huawei Cloud Horinger Data Center project - Yungu West Zone (Phase 1) had completed their construction completion-acceptance filing (竣工验收备案). The second batch comprises the 2# data-centre machine-room building and the 2# generator platform, about 45,717.7 m2 of floor area. The record covers construction completion of that second-batch scope only: operation is described as a next step and is not asserted, the planned cabinet and server numbers are not treated as installed capacity, and the other West Zone Phase 1 buildings, the West Zone 220 kV substation and the separate South and North Zones of the Huawei Horinger project are not included.

locator.precision: EIA centre point of the West Zone Phase 1 project's own 220 kV substation building (147.1 m x 42.2 m), which the report states is one of the West Zone Phase 1 buildings and lies inside that project's land. Locates the West Zone campus through on-campus power infrastructure at its south side; not the 2# machine-room building whose completion is recorded, nor an entrance or parcel centroid. The campus's data-centre buildings lie north of the point.
locator.identity_review: The report form published by the Inner Mongolia Department of Ecology and Environment with its approval-result publicity of 10 February 2025 is for the 220 kV substation of the Huawei Cloud Horinger Data Center project - Yungu West Zone (Phase 1), built by Huawei Cloud Computing Technology Co., Ltd. It places the project east of Jingu Road, south of Yunzhan Avenue, west of Shengguo Road and north of Yunchi Avenue in the Yungu area, states that the substation is one of the West Zone Phase 1 buildings and built entirely inside its land, and appends the project's filing notice (Horinger New Area Management Committee, 13 June 2024, project code 2306-150123-89-04-325368; three data-centre machine-room buildings with generator platforms, a 220 kV substation and ancillary buildings on about 174,096 m2). The 23 September 2026 status record names the same West Zone Phase 1 project. Printed E111°48'10.292", N40°32'0.593", transcribed arithmetically. The report's four side points bracket the centre within 3-6 m and describe a 152 m x 49 m footprint on a 67.5-degree axis, matching the printed building; read as WGS84 the centre falls on the roof of that building in independent Esri imagery and the report's Bank of China noise point falls in the neighbouring compound to the west; the GCJ-02 reading would put it about 594 m west-south-west beside a road. Details: sources/research-countries-2026-10-27-cn-inner-mongolia-p4-huawei-horinger-west-zone-geometry-facts.json.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No datum or positional accuracy is stated. The WGS84/CGCS2000 reading is supported by the report's internally consistent side points and by agreement with independent Esri imagery of unstated accuracy and date within about 10-15 m (manual visual comparison). The point marks the campus's substation building at its south side, up to a few hundred metres from the machine-room buildings. Decimal places are transcription precision, not accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: Screened on 27 October 2026 the names, aliases, operators, addresses and coordinates (华为/Huawei, 华为云和林格尔数据中心, 云谷西区/Yungu West Zone, 华为云计算技术有限公司, 金谷路/云展大街/盛国路/云翅大街, 和林格尔/Horinger, project code 2306-150123-89-04-325368) against sites.csv, projects.csv, evidence.csv, source-records.json and identity-mapping.json of verified_construction_core/2026-10-27-research-eightyfifth, every sources/*holds*.json file, the changes.json of every other queue fragment and queue/claims.tsv. The only Huawei records in the Atlas are the Huawei Cloud Ulanqab Phase 3 campus and its DC5 project, about 135 km east; no Horinger Huawei record exists. Atlas records within 2 km: BONC Horinger Intelligent Computing Centre (vcc-site-8b806f7ae4b0034de59b, 1,154 m north-east, separate operator and block) and China Mobile Hohhot Data Center (vcc-site-23ffbb893f12f178d8d3, 1,204 m east-north-east, separate operator; two projects). The Agricultural Bank of China Horinger data centre added by this fragment lies 542 m north-west across a trunk road (separate owner and campus), and the Northern Data Lake park held by this fragment lies 1,257 m north. The Bank of China data centre 144 m west (not an Atlas record) is a separate compound. No other queue fragment adds or claims a record within 2 km. Holds resolved: the thirty-fourth published hold for the Huawei Cloud Horinger West Zone and North Zone (West Zone part only) and the cn-north-p1 hold for West Zone Phase 1 batch 2, whose reopen condition was an EIA or substation report coordinate for a named Huawei Horinger zone. Not added: West Zone batch 1, the South Zone 3# building (topped out, reported 9 and 13 October 2026) and the North Zone, whose locations are not established by this report.
additions.successor_review: Re-checked 27 October 2026: the Horinger New Area news lists (pages 0-12, 26 October back to 28 July 2026), notices and government-meeting lists carry no later West Zone record after 23 September 2026 apart from the 15 October planning-committee review of a West Zone Phase 1 scheme change (a planning matter, not a change of physical status) and the 9 and 13 October South Zone topping-out items (a different zone). No operation, pause or other change of the second-batch works was found. Keep completed as of 23 September 2026.

additions.name: Agricultural Bank of China Horinger Data Center — newly commissioned data-centre operations

status.summary: On 31 August 2026 the Horinger New Area public affairs service bureau (emergency bureau) reported a safety inspection of the Agricultural Bank of China data centre as a newly put-into-production operating unit (新投产运营单位) in its initial production period, checking its fire control room, machine rooms, fire alarm linkage and gas suppression systems, emergency power and equipment-room environmental monitoring, and noting that the data centre carries the safe operation of financial business systems. The record covers the data centre's operation as of the publication date; the commissioning date, the buildings in service and any capacity are not stated, and the EIA's Phase 1 and Phase 2 building programmes and 366 MW load are planned figures that are not asserted.

locator.precision: The campus's Data 1# 110 kV substation, which the EIA places inside the data-centre campus on its south side, west of the south main gate and about 20 m north of Yungu Heng 44 Road; converted from the printed GCJ-02-frame value. Locates the campus through on-campus power infrastructure at its south edge; not a machine-room building, entrance or parcel centroid. The Phase 1 machine-room buildings lie roughly 100-300 m north-east of the point.
locator.identity_review: The report form published by the Inner Mongolia Department of Ecology and Environment with its approval-result publicity of 15 March 2023 is for the two 110 kV substations of the Agricultural Bank of China Data Centre Third Branch Horinger New Area construction project (项目代码 2106-150123-89-01-134187), invested and built by the Agricultural Bank of China Inner Mongolia Branch on plot E01-04-01 at the south-west end of the Yungu area; it states both stations are inside the campus on its south side either side of the south gate. The 31 August 2026 status record names the Agricultural Bank of China data centre in Horinger New Area; no other Agricultural Bank data centre exists in the New Area records reviewed. The printed Data 1# value (111°48'16.892", 40°32'15.910") carries no datum. Read directly as WGS84 the two printed stations would straddle the Shengguo Road trunk road and the eastern one would sit at the southern edge of the separate BONC campus, contradicting the report's single-rectangle site plan; read as GCJ-02 and converted to WGS84 (published open-source GCJ-02 inverse, round-trip residual below 1e-9 degrees) both fall at the south edge of one road-bounded campus whose width between two north-south roads (about 1,159 m), south-gate plaza and symmetric machine-room building groups match the plan within about 30 m in independent Esri imagery. The converted Data 1# point is used. Details: sources/research-countries-2026-10-27-cn-inner-mongolia-p4-abc-horinger-data-center-geometry-facts.json.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No datum or positional accuracy is stated; the GCJ-02 frame is inferred from the fit of the report's site plan to independent Esri imagery of unstated accuracy and date (manual visual comparison, agreement within about 30 m), and the printed value may itself have been read from a web map. The point marks a substation at the campus's south edge. Decimal places are computational precision, not accuracy.

additions.name: China Mobile Hohhot Data Center — B02 machine building operations
additions.site_identity_review: The 12 October 2026 New Area item names the China Mobile Hohhot Data Center (中国移动呼和浩特数据中心) in Horinger New Area, the existing Atlas campus, and its B02 machine building (B02机楼). B02 is a separate numbered building from the campus's B25/B27 expansion (completed 10 October 2026), and it is not the liquid-cooled intelligent computing centre recorded as the campus's other project: the New Area's 10 August 2026 item gives that centre a machine-room PUE as low as 1.15, while B02's PUE is reported as 1.315 falling to 1.209 with its cooling supplied from power-plant waste heat. This addition records the operation of the B02 building only and does not duplicate either existing project.

status.summary: On 12 October 2026 the Horinger New Area investment promotion services bureau stated that the China Mobile Hohhot Data Center's B02 machine building has been put into operation (B02机楼已投运), its PUE falling from 1.315 to 1.209 with cooling supplied by waste heat from the Jingneng Shengle thermal power plant over a 4.6 km pipeline, and about 560,000 kWh saved so far. The record covers operation of the B02 building as of the publication date only; its original service date, IT capacity and rack count are not stated, the PUE values are the bureau's description (measurement period unknown) and are not recorded as efficiency observations, and the other machine buildings, the liquid-cooled intelligent computing centre and the B25/B27 expansion are not included.

locator.identity_review: This reuses the existing campus point, a representative point inside the community-mapped named China Mobile Hohhot Data Center parent campus, with its pinned evidence and unchanged uncertainty. The point locates the parent campus. It does not identify the B02 building, whose position within the campus is not published. The baseline B25/B27 project has no geometry-identity evidence, so none is pinned.

Site vcc-site-23ffbb893f12f178d8d3 has two projects: the B25/B27 expansion (completed 10 October 2026) and the existing liquid-cooled intelligent computing centre operations (operational 27 August 2026); neither names B02, and no Atlas record, hold or queue fragment covers the B02 building.
